<?php
class ReturnBase160 {
    public static function Target160() { echo "BAD-TARGET|"; }
}
class ReturnChild160 extends ReturnBase160 {}
$method160 = 'ReturnBase160::Target160';
$mode160 = 'normal';
$notices160 = 0;
$lookupThrow160 = new Exception('lookup');
function returnNotice160($level, $message) {
    ++$GLOBALS['notices160'];
    echo 'notice:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
    if ($GLOBALS['mode160'] === 'change') {
        $GLOBALS['method160'] = 'ReturnBase160::Target160';
    }
    if ($GLOBALS['mode160'] === 'throw-invalid') {
        $GLOBALS['method160'] = 'ReturnBase160::Absent160';
    }
    if ($GLOBALS['mode160'] === 'throw-valid' || $GLOBALS['mode160'] === 'throw-invalid') {
        throw $GLOBALS['lookupThrow160'];
    }
    return true;
}
set_error_handler('returnNotice160');
function makeReturn160(): callable {
    global $method160;
    try {
        echo 'body:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
        return ['ReturnChild160', &$method160];
    } finally {
        echo 'finally:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
        $method160 = 'AFTER';
    }
}
foreach (['normal', 'change', 'throw-valid', 'throw-invalid'] as $mode160) {
    $method160 = 'ReturnBase160::Target160';
    if ($mode160 === 'change') { $method160 = 'ReturnBase160::Absent160'; }
    $result160 = 'UNCHANGED';
    try {
        $result160 = makeReturn160();
        echo 'returned:', $result160[0], ':', $result160[1], '|';
    } catch (Throwable $caught160) {
        echo 'caught:', get_class($caught160), ':', (int)($caught160 === $lookupThrow160), ':', (int)($caught160->getPrevious() === $lookupThrow160), ':', $result160, '|';
    }
    unset($caught160, $result160);
}
function arrayBypass160($value): callable|array {
    try { return $value; } finally { echo 'array-finally|'; }
}
function objectBypass160($value): callable|object { return $value; }
function nullableBypass160(): ?callable { return null; }
$method160 = 'ReturnBase160::Target160';
$before160 = $notices160;
$bypass160 = arrayBypass160(['ReturnChild160', &$method160]);
$object160 = new stdClass();
$objectReturn160 = objectBypass160($object160);
echo 'bypass:', (int)($notices160 === $before160), ':', (int)($objectReturn160 === $object160), ':', (int)(nullableBypass160() === null), ':', $bypass160[1], '|';
purpose: Lookup occurs before finally, resumed method aliases stay live, successful verification is not repeated after finally, and valid/invalid handler throws preserve distinct Exception/TypeError Previous outcomes. Exact array/object/nullable union alternatives bypass lookup.

<?php
class ReturnReceiver160 {
    public function Target160() { echo "BAD-TARGET|"; }
    public function __destruct() { echo 'receiver:', $GLOBALS['phase160'], '|'; }
}
class ReturnReceiverChild160 extends ReturnReceiver160 {}
$method160 = 'ReturnReceiver160::Target160';
$mode160 = 'normal';
$phase160 = 'before';
$lookupThrow160 = new Exception('lookup');
function ownerNotice160($level, $message) {
    echo 'notice:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
    if ($GLOBALS['mode160'] === 'throw-invalid') {
        $GLOBALS['method160'] = 'ReturnReceiver160::Absent160';
    }
    if ($GLOBALS['mode160'] !== 'normal') { throw $GLOBALS['lookupThrow160']; }
    return true;
}
set_error_handler('ownerNotice160');
function ownedReturn160(): callable {
    global $method160;
    try {
        echo 'body:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
        return [new ReturnReceiverChild160(), &$method160];
    } finally {
        $GLOBALS['phase160'] = 'finally';
        echo 'finally:', $GLOBALS['mode160'], '|';
        $method160 = 'AFTER';
    }
}
foreach (['normal', 'throw-valid', 'throw-invalid'] as $mode160) {
    $method160 = 'ReturnReceiver160::Target160';
    $phase160 = 'lookup';
    $result160 = 'UNCHANGED';
    try {
        $result160 = ownedReturn160();
        echo 'returned:', $result160[1], '|';
        $phase160 = 'caller';
        unset($result160);
    } catch (Throwable $caught160) {
        echo 'caught:', get_class($caught160), ':', (int)($caught160 === $lookupThrow160), ':', (int)($caught160->getPrevious() === $lookupThrow160), ':', $result160, '|';
    }
    unset($caught160, $result160);
    echo 'settled:', $mode160, '|';
}
purpose: A direct receiver is owned by the actual returned array temporary through successful or pending lookup. Normal caller release, valid handler throw after finally and invalid lookup before finally retain their distinct physical drain order.
